items.title: Bo Nix's 12th TD pass of the season gives Broncos 10-0 lead over Raiders
items.text: The Broncos have gotten into the end zone.

items.title: Fernando Mendoza throws first touchdown pass, Raiders trail Broncos 17-10
items.text: Fernando Mendoza ran it into the end zone for his first professional touchdown last week.

items.title: Broncos lead Raiders 17-10 at halftime
items.text: The Broncos got out to a 17-0 lead, but the Raiders have settled in after a rough start to narrow that advantage to 17-10 at halftime.

items.title: Fernando Mendoza's second TD pass tied Raiders-Broncos at 17-17
items.text: The Raiders are back in business.

items.title: Broncos move to 8-2 with 38-24 victory over Raiders
items.text: A pick-six off of Fernando Mendoza late in the fourth quarter sealed Denver's win.

items.title: Officials give Jameis Winston a TD, replays appear to show he was down before scoring
items.text: The officials gave Giants quarterback Jameis Winston a touchdown on a fourth-and-goal tush push today against the Jaguars, but on replay it's not at all clear that Winston actually scored.

items.title: Officials deny Jaguars TD on sensational catch by Parker Washington
items.text: Washington appeared to make a superb touchdown catch, but the officials and the replay office ruled it incomplete.

items.title: Giants earn their most impressive win of the season with upset of Jaguars
items.text: The NFC East leaders surprised the AFC South leaders today.

items.title: Liam Coen: I was told ball switched hands on Parker Washington catch
items.text: The Giants held off the Jaguars on Sunday, but the outcome might have been different if referees had made a different ruling on a pass to Jaguars wideout Parker Washington early in the fourth quarter.

items.title: Liam Coen: Everything said kick FG late in fourth, going for it a "hope play"
items.text: Jaguars head coach Liam Coen opted to kick a field goal from the 9-yard-line and cut the Giants' lead to 23-18 with just over three minutes to play in Sunday's game, but hopes of winning the game with a touchdown went up in smoke when the Giants picked up two first downs and ran out the clock.

items.title: NFL says Parker Washington didn't control ball until he was out of bounds
items.text: Sunday's game between the Jaguars and Giants included a controversial decision in the fourth quarter on a play that looked like a touchdown catch by Jacksonville receiver Parker Washington.

items.title: Jets end touchdown drought, lead Chargers 10-3
items.text: The Jets have found their way back to the end zone.

items.title: Jets lead Chargers 17-10 at halftime
items.text: The Jets didn't score a touchdown in Weeks 9 or 10, but they doubled down on them in the first half of their Week 11 game against the Chargers.

items.title: Jets beat Chargers 27-24 to end five-game losing streak
items.text: The Jets scored on their first five possessions and then ran out the clock on the Chargers from there.

items.title: Sunday Night Football: 49ers lead Vikings 28-10 at halftime
items.text: QB Brock Purdy threw three TD passes in the first half, two of which went to TE George Kittle.

items.title: 49ers RT Colton McKivitz carted off in an air cast with apparent significant injury
items.text: 49ers right tackle Colton McKivitz has suffered a significant injury in the second quarter of Sunday night's matchup against the Vikings.

items.title: George Kittle's second TD gives 49ers 14-7 lead
items.text: Once again, George Kittle has made it into the end zone.

items.title: Aaron Jones TD ties Vikings-49ers at 7-7 late in first quarter
items.text: The Vikings have tied things up in Mexico City.

items.title: DK Metcalf's 2025 suspension can be factor in discipline for Sunday's ejection
items.text: Steelers receiver DK Metcalf was ejected from Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.

items.title: Brock Purdy caps first drive with TD pass to George Kittle, 49ers lead 7-0
items.text: Much was made about the matchup between 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan and Vikings defensive coordinator Brian Flores in advance of Sunday night's matchup between San Francisco and Minnesota.

items.title: Joe Brady: We can't focus on result, there's a lot to clean up
items.text: The Bills won again on Sunday, but head coach Joe Brady didn't sound enthused about the way they played against the Dolphins.

items.title: NFL Playoff Picture 2026: Updated AFC and NFC standings, bracket, tiebreakers for Week 11
items.text: Sunday night's Vikings-49ers game is a very big one in the NFC playoff race.

items.title: Robert Saleh: We played disgusting football on Sunday
items.text: The Titans were on the receiving end of a thrashing in Dallas on Sunday.

items.title: Justin Herbert is in concussion protocol
items.text: Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert played the entire game in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets, but he did not emerge from it unscathed.

items.title: Sunday Night Football: Mike Evans active, Dre Greenlaw inactive for 49ers-Vikings
items.text: Evans will play his first game since Oct. 19 on Sunday night in Mexico City.

items.title: Bills can match their best record through 10 games, with a win over Dolphins
items.text: The 8-1 Bills, barring a massive upset, will move to 9-1 today.

items.title: Bills pull off fake punt, extend lead to 6-0
items.text: The Bills reached into their bag of tricks in the first quarter of Sunday's home game against the Dolphins and it paid off for them.

items.title: James Cook goes over 1,000 rushing yards, puts Bills up 20-3
items.text: The Bills were heavy favorites coming into Sunday's game against the Dolphins and they have played like it in the first half.

items.title: Bills lead Dolphins 20-6 at halftime
items.text: The Bills have a big game against the Chiefs on Thanksgiving night, but they haven't gotten caught looking ahead against the Dolphins this Sunday.

items.title: Tyler Bass misses first field goal of season, Bills lead 20-9
items.text: Bills kicker Tyler Bass extended his run of made field goals to open the season to 22 in the first half against the Dolphins on Sunday, but it won't get any longer.
